page.layout: One printed page, one column of running text, top to bottom. No marginal notes on this scan. Reference marks 9 and 20 stand in the text. A strip of the neighbouring page at the far right edge is not transcribed.

main_text.p: nenses; easque pari pietatis affectu ac reverentia suscipiendas & venerandas decreverunt, sicut scripturam ipsam. Deinde scripturā ipsam secundum sensum vel depravatione ecclesiæ suæ Romanæ explicari volunt. Hoccine est instituere omnia ad normam scripturæ propheticæ & apostolicæ?{9} Nullam affulgere reconciliationis spem inter partes dissentientes in orbe Christiano, si annihiletur vel extenuetur Tridentina synodi auctoritas. &c.[?] Ergo dicamus cum Augustino lib. 3. contra Maxim. cap.14. Neque ego hujus, neque tu illius auctoritate detineris; scripturarum auctoritatibus, non quorumcunque propriis, sed utrisque communibus testibus: res cum re, causa cum causâ, ratio cum ratione decertet.

Praeterea confugiunt ad Patres. Resp. At neque nobis desunt Patrum suffragia, quæ notavimus supra: deinde, quanta sit eorum auctoritas docuimus in Medullâ Papismi in loco de Patribus.{20} Ajunt veteres Imperatores sub gravissimarum poenarum comminatione

page.notes: Reference marks {9} and {20} appear in the text, but no matching notes are printed in the margins of this scan. The left margin is clear. The line "&c." after the italic sentence is doubtful: the glyph may be ⁊c. The last word "natione" is printed at the right of the final line and is continued on the next page. The word "easque" carries a doubtful accent. Long s is normalised to s throughout.
